It would be cool if /v/music was more of a music discussion subverse and /v/listentothis could be for plain submissions. As the site grows, we're going to have a lot more people coming in to both subs and a line will have to be drawn as to what makes each subverse what it is. Music discussion, talking about bands, genres and anything else should happen here. I believe that talking about music as a community and what it means to us is hugely more beneficial than just being inundated with new music posts.

I remember going over to a friends house and talking about the new Offspring album and how cool it was or being introduced to The Beastie Boys for the first time and a good friend taking me through the motions that encompassed their whole style. Listening to music in good headphones when you're by yourself is great, but I think that we're losing something in that. Music is also a communal thing, and we benefit a lot from these shared experiences.

Thank you for reading.

I just ran out of my most recent batch of simple syrup and was looking for a new flavor. I've tried honey, ginger (my favorite), and rosemary this summer. I kind of want to try out lavender or jalapeno. What do you guys like?

Edit: I kind of cheated the question and made both. Live big, I guess! Now to try some new drinks!
What is your favorite infused simple syrup.
I have a bunch of lavender in my back yard, it makes fantastic simple syrup. Goes very well with gin. Cardamom is also another fun one.
Do you have any good recipes for your lavender syrup?

Honestly, part of me feels like it's cheating, but a mint-infused simple syrup definitely makes it easier to bang out tons of Mojitos, Juleps, etc. Some people like to steep mint into the syrup overnight in the fridge, but I think it works better if you boil the sugar and water until dissolved and then boil with the mint for about 3 minutes (or to taste). I feel like that pulls out more flavor without extracting too much of the bitter chlorophyll.
I wouldn't call it cheating, it just makes it way easier if you're making a bunch of drinks. If I'm just doing one for myself though I like to take the time to muddle the mint and everything.
Yeah, the part of me that is worried about cheating goes right out the window when I'm staring at 2 dozen empty glasses looking to get filled pronto.

This isn't cheating, it's being more efficient and planning ahead. Especially if you know you're about to make like 40 mojitos or juleps or whatever in a night. Plus, it also makes it easier to throw mint into other drinks as a little twist, or throw down a southside if somebody wants something a little different.
I made a blood orange/basil simple syrup, weak on the sugar (1/2) and its wonder ful in bourbon or rye with some bitters.
Habanero or jalapeno. It doesn't go with everything, but mango/lime/lemon based drinks work.
